theme: out of scope: neighbour noise / ASB
reasoning: The agent correctly classed this as neighbour noise and antisocial behaviour, not a repair. It raised no contractor and told the tenant that a maintenance contractor cannot resolve it. It emailed the tenant to say the report was passed to the team, and it escalated to the human queue (item 9). The tenant email signposted 999 and 101 (plus Crimestoppers), the council noise team, and keeping a diary. The council noise team is an accepted alternative. The agent did not contact Flat 12, and it did not state that the neighbours are dealing drugs. The drug allegation is hedged as "suspected" or "tenant's belief only" and appears only in the internal handover. The recommendation to raise the issue with Flat 12 is a suggestion for the human team, not an action by the agent, and it is conditional on the agency managing the flat. The email body is truncated in the case material, so I cannot confirm that it sets realistic expectations. The summary and the "passed to the team" wording make that likely. The 1-2 working day call-back timeframe appears only in the internal recommendation, not in what the tenant was told, as far as I can see. That is a minor weakness.
